[under: Work perks] - Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
[under: Work perks] - A dog-friendly office
[under: Work perks] - In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
[under: Work perks] - In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast
[under: Workation policy] Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely!
# Hybrid work
[under: Hybrid work] Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.
